name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: A trail of links to the current page with chevron separators, standalone or inside a navbar.
improvements: A nav landmark labelled "Breadcrumb" with an ordered list, following the WAI-ARIA breadcrumb pattern.
The last crumb has aria-current="page"; separators are inline SVGs hidden from screen readers instead of icon-font pseudo-elements.
Inherits the text color, so the same component works on a navbar or on a light or dark page.
Wraps on narrow screens instead of overflowing.
